scientific.integrity: The proof is algebraic from the exact CSD spectral recurrence. Exact Q(sqrt(2)) replay verifies the stated projective orbit and the 1/49 specialization without floating-point identity checks.
scientific.limitations: The theorem classifies only full-support reversal-symmetric projective two-cycles for three distinct active eigenvalues and cycle length two; it does not classify all exceptional CSD orbits. Full text of the close Li--Wang preprint was not available for line-by-line comparison, leaving a stated residual originality risk.

title: Arithmetic spectra are exactly the reversal-symmetric three-mode CSD exception
